boundary_evidence: Eleven consecutive delinked functions at 0x0203ac80..0x0203ad84, all complete: the five named PathPtr members (FromID, GetNode, Loops, NumNodes, C1) plus six anonymous func_ shards that resolve to the class's accessors (func_0203ad44 -> flags&0x7f, func_0203ad54 -> unk_004, func_0203ad6c -> def store called only by FromID) and its three path-table helpers (func_0203aca0/0203acbc/0203accc on data_020a0d84/88/8c, the PathDef/node tables LoadPathObjects hands it).

func_0203ad84 at 0x0203ad84 closes the run: a string-copy helper on unrelated globals (data_020994d4, data_020a0d90) with no PathPtr receiver, folded in under its func_ name the same way dBgPi kept its neighbouring shards.
Preceded by the dM3dGSph member run ending at C2 0x0203ac70..0x0203ac80; followed by DecIfAbove0_Short's math family. The span is the whole class.
PathPtr is non-polymorphic: no _ZTS/_ZTI/_ZTV for it exists in the ROM. PATH_DEFS is the 4-byte BSS pointer this TU claims; PATH_NODES and NUM_PATHS stay in the gap.

bss.evidence: level PathDef table pointer; the BSS word is 0 and SetPathTable stores the loaded table

notes: Six members arrived as anonymous func_ shards; symbols.txt names them by their member spellings. GetPullFactor reads def->flags & 0x7f -- the low seven bits under Loops' 0x80 closed-path bit -- which path-follow code scales a lateral offset by. GetUnk004 reads the remaining opaque PathDef byte. SetDef is the def-pointer store FromID goes through. SetPathTable/GetNodeTable/SetNodeTable manage the level's PATH_DEFS/PATH_NODES/NUM_PATHS globals (0x020a0d84/88/8c). PATH_DEFS is this TU's BSS claim; PATH_NODES and NUM_PATHS stay gap-served. LoadPathObjects and LoadPathNodeObjects load them; they are statics on the class because GetNode calls GetNodeTable as its own plumbing.
mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order, so the file lists C1 first and FromID last; the manifest ordinals run ROM-ascending.
